identificationModule.briefTitle: Triggering Oocyte Maturation in Normoresponders Using Double Trigger or HCG Trigger
identificationModule.officialTitle: Triggering Oocyte Maturation in Normoresponders Using Double Trigger or HCG Trigger . A Randomized Controlled Trial

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The aim of this study is to compare the efficacy double trigger \[ co-administration of GnRH agonist with HCG 40 and 34 h prior to ovum pick-up, respectively\] with HCG trigger in inducing oocyte maturation.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription:
Several studies revealed that the double trigger regimen was effective in the treatment of patients with a history of immature oocytes retrieved or with suboptimal oocytes yield.

The investigators designed this randomized controlled trial to compare the efficacy double trigger with HCG trigger in inducing oocyte maturation.in normoreponders undergoing IVF-ET

armGroups.label: Double trigger
armGroups.description: GnRH agonist ( Triptorelin ) ( 0.2 mg / S.C ) and hCG ( 10000 IU) are administered 40 and 34 h before oocyte retrieval

armGroups.label: HCG trigger
armGroups.description: HCG ( 100000 IU/ I.M ) is administered 36 h before oocyte retrieval

interventions.name: Double trigger
interventions.description: GnRH agonist ( Triptorelin ) ( 0.2 mg / S.C ) and hCG ( 10000 IU) are administered 40 and 34 h before ovum pick-up

interventions.name: HCG trigger
interventions.description: hCG ( 10000 IU) is administered 36 h before ovum pick-up

primaryOutcomes.description: Number of MII oocyte/ number of cumulus oocyte complex
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Ten to fifteen days after starting ovarian stimulation

secondaryOutcomes.description: Presence of intrauterine gestational sac detected by transvaginal ultrasound

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Normoresponders
* GnRH antagonist cycles

Exclusion Criteria:

* BMI more than 35
* Endometriosis
* AMH less than 1.1 ng
* AMH more than 4
* PCOS
* Poor responders
